listing.name: Arthr's Ships n' Shit - pre-release 0.100
listing.summary: after 9 years in development I return to you with 2 new ships, 1 halfbaked gameplay system and 4 short missions making this a vanilla-quality mod

description:
*after 9 years in development I return to you with 2 new ships, 1 halfbaked gameplay system and 4 short missions*
*making this a vanilla-quality mod*

Main Features:
- Mobile, upgradable battle colonies
- Some interesting ships and weapons
- Pirates now ask for your stuff instead of going for the throat straight up 

If unsure about whether or not the mod is good just ask around in <#512356777451323393> I'm sure they'll know.

**Forum post:**
(coming with full fire and forget release)
**Download link:**
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1CaEc5i4BSJDPZYGMUKwsNx5Hz5Wev6f8/view?usp=sharing

**NOTE:**
**THIS BREAKS SAVES IF YOU WERE RUNNING THE 0.96 VERSION**
This is the preliminary release without me having done any in depth test runs, send any new bugs/crashes my way I'll try to hotfix this up enough that I can forget about it.
